results.expected: Landed 20" casing at 1358 meter by setting down 15 Ton on hanger.
Ran in hole with cement stinger from 5 1/2" drill pipe from 2505m MD to 14" casing shoe at 2570,7m MD.

sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-11 T2 on Volve has 53 daily reports, from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14.
The report span is 52.96 days with 53 active days, in 1 campaign.
The deepest measured depth reported is 4562.1 m with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m; Sodir gives a total depth of 4562.0 m.
Total activity time is 1230.5 h, of which primary lost time is 145.0 h, a share of 11.78 % of the activity time.

The main outcome: the observation wellbore reached its deepest depth in the 8.5 in section, was plugged back with cement, and the rig kicked off to F-11 A from the plug; Sodir lists the status as P&A.
Campaign 1 runs from 2013-03-23 to 2013-05-14, a span of 52.96 days with 53 active days, and its dominant operation phase is drilling.
There was no later completion, workover or abandonment campaign; the well was drilled in one campaign.
Section 1 is a 26.0 in hole, from 2013-03-23 to 2013-04-12, drilled from 257.0 m to 1365.0 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 1340.5 m at section end.
Section 1 drilled 1108.0 m of new hole at an average rate of 16.0 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (an average over all time with that code, not an on-bottom rate of penetration).
Section 2 is a 17.5 in hole, from 2013-04-13 to 2013-04-27, drilled from 1368.0 m to 2577.0 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 2444.0 m at section end.
Section 2 drilled 1212.0 m of new hole at an average rate of 14.87 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).
Section 3 is an 8.5 in hole, from 2013-04-28 to 2013-05-08, drilled from 2577.0 m to 4562.1 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m at section end.
Section 3 drilled 1985.1 m of new hole at an average rate of 14.0 m/h while coded drilling -- drill (not an on-bottom rate of penetration).

Section 4 has an unknown hole size (the reports do not state one, so the tool gives hole_size_source unknown); it runs from 2013-05-09 to 2013-05-14, from 4562.0 m to 4562.1 m measured depth, with a true vertical depth of 3398.2 m at section end.
Section 4 drilled 0.0 m of new hole, so no drilling rate is given (reason: no new hole); it holds the cement plugs and the start of the kick-off to F-11 A.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 202.3 m and set casing with its shoe at 1357.7 m.

sentences.text: A later report names that casing:
Section 3 starts below the shoe at 2570.7 m and no casing was set in it (casing shoe null in the tool).
Section 4 also starts below the shoe at 2570.7 m and no casing was set in it.
Primary lost time in section 1 is 58.5 h, 12.33 % of that section's activity time.
Primary lost time in section 2 is 86.5 h, 24.03 % of that section's activity time.
Sections 3 and 4 have no primary lost time.
By cause, primary lost time is 74.0 h of waiting on weather (15 activities) and 71.0 h of repair (31 activities); together they make the wellbore's 145.0 h, which is 11.78 % of its activity time.
Possible lost time, kept separate and not added to the primary figures, is 152.25 h, 12.37 % of the wellbore's activity time.
By cause the possible time is 73.25 h of maintain, 46.25 h of other and 32.75 h of wait; these codes may or may not be lost time.
On 2013-03-24 the crown block fast-line sheave was found with a seized bearing; a 4.0 h activity records the check and the plan to pull the 26.0 in BHA (coded possible lost time).
The BHA was pulled to surface, and on 2013-03-27 an 8.0 h activity repaired the failed sheave and re-assembled its bearing assembly (coded possible lost time).

On 2013-04-04 the wellhead could not reach a correct torque-turn graph and a casing joint with damaged box threads was replaced, and a backup wellhead was used; this took 6.0 h of primary repair time.

From 2013-04-15 the rig waited on weather because cuttings from the ISO tanks could not be back-loaded to the supply vessel in heavy wind and sea; one activity that day lasted 16.0 h, and the waiting recurred until 2013-04-19.
On 2013-04-24 a drawworks failure was troubleshot for 5.0 h of primary repair time while the casing hanger was being lowered below the rotary.

On 2013-05-08, after the total depth was reached, the 8.5 in BHA hit a restriction on the trip out, needed rotation to pass it and met tight spots further up; the trip activity lasted 5.25 h and is not coded as lost time.
Cement plugs were then set through a cement stinger, starting on 2013-05-10, and hard cement was tagged on 2013-05-12.

Sodir gives a completion date of 2013-05-12 (end of drilling, not production start-up), while the last report is 2013-05-14, because after the plugs the BHA was run back, cement was drilled out and the rig kicked off to F-11 A in a 1.0 h activity, and operations were then transferred to F-11 A.

Plan cuttings back-loading capacity and a weather margin for the top sections, since waiting on weather cost 74.0 h of primary lost time, and primary lost time reached 24.03 % of the activity time in the 17.5 in section.
Inspect and grease-test the crown block sheaves and other critical lifting equipment before spud, because the sheave failure of 2013-03-24 stopped drilling in the 26.0 in section for several days.
Inspect casing thread boxes and pre-test the wellhead running tool and torque-turn setup before running the surface casing, to avoid a repeat of the 6.0 h repair on 2013-04-04.
Equipment repair totalled 71.0 h of primary lost time across 31 activities, so pipe-handling, power tong, riser guide funnel and drawworks checks should be part of the pre-spud rig acceptance.
Condition the hole and plan reaming and back-reaming practice before pulling out of the deepest section, given the restriction and tight spots met on 2013-05-08.

Record the hole size in the reports for the plug-and-kick-off section, because section 4 has an unknown hole size in the data, and keep the plug programme and the kick-off plan aligned so that the Sodir completion date and the last report date can be reconciled directly.

row.comments:
Checked crown block fast-line sheave and found bearing ceased onto shaft. Evaluated situation and informed offshore and onshore managment. Prepared forward plan to POOH 26" BHA prior to working on fast-line sheave. Barriered off rig floor and cantelever.

Meanwhile:
Circulated well 1100 l/min, 8 bar, 20 RPM, 2 kNm. Attempted to apply lubricant to fast-line sheave.

Repaired failed fast line sheave and re-assembled bearing assembly. 

Meanwhile: Performed service and visual inspection of forward and aft Pipe Racking System. Continued BOP annular repair. Tested backup MWD tools. Serviced TDS travelling block and dolly. Repaired TDS hangoff wire.

Broke out wellhead from string and laid down same to deck.
Pulled out of hole with 20" casing string from 1208 m to 1195 m and broke out joint with damaged box threads, laid down same to deck.
Picked up and made up new 20" casing joint and ran in hole to 1208 meter.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment.
Prepared backup wellhead on HTS, made up same to running tool.
Picked up and made up backup wellhead assembly.
Installed  plug set in backup wellhead assembly.

Landed 20" casing at 1358 meter by setting down 15 Ton on hanger.
Performed over pull test to 270 Ton. ( 25 Ton overpull)

Waited on weather.
Not able to back load cuttings from ISO tanks to supply vessel due to heavy wind and sea.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1440 liter/min, 35 bar.
Picked up and racked back 5 1/2" DP, 23 stands racked back.

Waited on weather to back load cuttings.

Meanwhile:
Circulated with 1420 lpm,  33 bar, 0 rpm.

Troubleshoot drawwork failure.

Meanwhile: 
Removed auto slips and lowered 14" casing hanger below rotary in a controlled sequence, Up/Dw weight 430/320 MT. Installed master bushing and made up circulation swedge. Circulated with 200 lpm, 9 bar, 14" casing shoe at 2433 m.

Pulled out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4562m MD to 4467m MD. Took 5MT overpull at 4467m MD. Attempted to pass restriction several times with maximum 30MT - no go. Attempted to run in hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly with up to 40 MT - no go. Established circulation with 1300 lpm and 54 bar, no losses. Attempted to establish rotation - no go. 

Applied full string weight, and established rotation. Reamed stand down from 4467m MD to 4482m MD. Attempted to ream stand up several times - no go. Stalled out at 4467m MD.
Stopped rotation and circulation and attempted to pull 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly out of hole from 4467m MD - no go. Established rotation with 50 rpm. Got passed restriction.

Pulled / reamed out of hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 4467m MD to 4407m MD with 1400 lpm, 31 bar, 50 rpm and 16-30 kNm. Observed tight spots at 4468m and 4460m.

Pumped 11.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Mixed and pumped 10 m3 of 1.90 sg cement slurry. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 890 l of drill water. Reset stroke counters. Pumped 2.8 m3 of 1.50 sg spacer. Displaced the cement with 40.6 m3 (1833 strokes) of 1.32 sg OBM. Underdisplaced with 2.5m3.

Rotated with 20 rpm and 15 kNm during displacement.
Ran in hole with cement stinger from 5 1/2" drill pipe from 2505m MD to 14" casing shoe at 2570,7m MD. Broke circulation with 2500 lpm and recorded pressures (179 bar). Took up and down weights.
Washed in hole with 3 1/2" cement stinger on 5 1/2" drill pipe from 4044m MD to 4104m MD with 200 lpm and 20 bar. Tagged hard cement at 4104 with 10MT.

Kicked off to F-11 A by drilling from 2578m MD to 2586m MDwith 1800 lpm, 120 bar and 60 rpm. 50% cement / formation in returns verified at 2586m MD.

****Transferred operations to F-11 A****
